decontamination_notes: Real defensive prototype-pollution hardening from honojs/hono PR #5161 (https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5161), merged 2026-07-24 -- after the training cutoffs of the models evaluated here (e.g. Opus 5, May 2026), so the specific fix is not in their training data (decontaminated: true). The vulnerable request-parsing sites build their result maps with a plain `{}` object literal, whose prototype is Object.prototype; a request-controlled `__proto__` key can therefore reach the prototype chain. The fix builds each map with Object.create(null) at three sites: getQueryParams (src/utils/url.ts), the Accept media-type param object (src/utils/accept.ts), and the header map in HonoRequest.header() (src/request.ts). Hono is a zero-runtime-dependency TypeScript package with extensionless ESM imports, so hidden tests run via tsx (pinned in the node-ts sandbox image) with the built-in node:test runner. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (75k LOC src tree, all three sites still using `{}`); MIT LICENSE preserved. Coverage floor: 3 fail_to_pass tests (one per parse site, each asserting a null prototype and that `__proto__` is stored as ordinary data) plus a null-prototype-independent regression guard over ordinary query/accept/header parsing.

fail_to_pass.name: query_null_proto
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb query params use a null-prototype object$' vb_proto_pollution.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: accept_null_proto
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb accept params use a null-prototype object$' vb_proto_pollution.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: header_null_proto
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb header map uses a null-prototype object$' vb_proto_pollution.test.ts

pass_to_pass.name: parsers_unaffected
pass_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb parsers unaffected for ordinary input$' vb_parsers_regression.test.ts
